title: fleetd default state-dir disagrees with the daemon's socket derivation
wanted_capability: One code-owned derivation of the fleetd state dir (socket and token) shared by the daemon client and the fleetd binary's --state-dir default. Today the daemon derives fleetd paths from its BRO dispatch store dir (state_dir/bro) via FleetdConfig::in_state_dir(store_dir) in install_configured_harness_executor, while fleetd's default_state_dir resolves the plain blackbox state dir ($BLACKBOX_STATE_DIR, else $XDG_STATE_HOME/blackbox, else ~/.local/state/blackbox) with no /bro suffix. Only the daemon auto-start passes an explicit --state-dir; a service unit that relies on fleetd's built-in default binds a socket the daemon never dials, and the daemon then auto-starts a second fleetd.
fallback_used: First prod rollout 2026-07-19: launchd unit with the plain state dir orphaned its fleetd while the daemon auto-started a second one at the derived path. Fixed operationally by pointing the unit's --state-dir at .../blackbox/bro; deploy/fleetd.plist and fleetd-dev.plist corrected with a comment explaining the derivation.
evidence: crates/fleetd/src/paths.rs: default_state_dir (plain state dir, no bro suffix)
src/orchestration/mod.rs: install_configured_harness_executor passes store_dir (state_dir/bro) to FleetdConfig::in_state_dir / resolve
deploy/fleetd.plist, deploy/fleetd-dev.plist, deploy/fleetd.service, deploy/fleetd-dev.service: must hard-code the .../blackbox/bro state dir to match
notes: Triage trace: still live. The launchd plists were corrected to pass .../blackbox/bro and .../blackbox-dev/bro, but deploy/fleetd.service still runs fleetd with no --state-dir (its comment claims the default matches the daemon, which is false), and deploy/fleetd-dev.service passes .../blackbox-dev without the bro suffix. On a systemd host both units bind a socket the daemon never dials.
